current_task_binding.dataset_name: NOAA CDR AVHRR NDVI: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index, Version 4

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land coverage on a 0.05 degree grid, including the Amazon basin, the Guiana Shield, the Cerrado and the Andean margin of tropical South America.

analytical_capabilities: Multi-decadal vegetation greenness analysis spanning the early 1980s onward
Daily-to-monthly aggregation for seasonal and interannual dynamics
Interannual coupling analysis against climate oscillation indices
Regional averaging and comparison across sub-regions of a continent
Lag and cross-correlation analysis between vegetation state and other monthly gridded variables

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDVI as a dimensionless index, stored with a scale factor of 0.0001
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Multiply `NDVI` by 0.0001 to obtain physical values. Screen observations with the `QA` bit flags before aggregating, since daily AVHRR retrievals are sensitive to cloud and off-nadir viewing. `TIMEOFDAY` gives hours since the start of day at a 0.01 scale, which reveals drift in acquisition time across the multi-decadal record. Daily sampling means monthly means need explicit handling of missing days rather than a plain average.

current_task_binding.data_source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, derived from AVHRR sensors

observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: NOAA Climate Data Record AVHRR NDVI production lineage
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: CDR version 4/5, archive, grid, resampling or temporal aggregation retaining the NOAA CDR NDVI observations
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: GIMMS, MODIS, SPOT, PROBA-V, Landsat or another AVHRR processing lineage without NOAA CDR input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: The NOAA Climate Data Record of AVHRR NDVI is admitted, either version 4 or version 5; MODIS MOD13/MYD13 tiers, GIMMS NDVI3g, SPOT VEGETATION, PROBA-V and Landsat-derived vegetation indices are excluded.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: This policy defines which product counts as the anchor, not whether a paper may also use other vegetation-index products. A study comparing AVHRR against MODIS is admissible as long as the CDR AVHRR series is itself operationally processed.

anchor_repointed.reason: The admitted product is the daily AVHRR Climate Data Record at 0.05 degrees, not a 250 m 16-day MODIS collection. MODIS also begins in 2000 and cannot support analysis reaching back to 1981.
anchor_repointed.verified_against: Earth Engine catalog entry NOAA/CDR/AVHRR/NDVI/V4 (daily cadence, 5566 m gsd corresponding to 0.05 degrees, NDVI at 0.0001 scale with TIMEOFDAY and QA bands, record 1981-06-24 to 2019-05-16)
anchor_repointed.version_choice: V4 is marked deprecated in the catalog while V5 is current, but V5 stops at 2013-12-31 whereas V4 runs to 2019-05. V4 is admitted because it is the only version covering the full period of interest; V5 remains acceptable under the alias policy for work confined to 1981-2013.
anchor_repointed.residual_gap: V4 carries a deprecated status, so it could be withdrawn from the catalog. Work that only needs 1981-2013 should prefer V5, which is current.

directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 气溶胶光学厚度、氮氧化物浓度、气象扩散条件、地表特征及植被绿度共同驱动颗粒物的生成、传输与沉降过程，其多模态联合输入可显著降低单一数据源的预测误差并提升PM2.5反演精度。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 使用MODIS MAIAC AOD、地面NO2监测、ERA5/MERRA2气象与气溶胶再分析、NOAA ISD能见度、GTOPO30高程、OpenStreetMap路网、Copernicus城市用地以及NOAA CDR AVHRR NDVI作为特征输入，构建包含随机森林、梯度提升和前馈神经网络的堆叠集成模型，以最小化预测误差并输出每日PM2.5浓度估计值。
directions.method_paradigm: 堆叠集成机器学习反演
used_assets: NOAA Climate Data Record AVHRR NDVI V5

directions.research_question: 该论文研究北阿尔伯塔 boreal forest 中泥炭地、气候、水文地形、燃料和植被物候如何影响火灾避难地出现概率。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 泥炭地和湿润地形通过提高水分可用性、改变燃料结构并与季节性植被物候共同作用，从而增加火灾中保留未燃烧斑块的可能性。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 论文使用 AlbertaSeverityAtlasdataset 的 RBR 标识火灾避难地，使用 NOAA CDR AVHRR NDVI, Version 4 的火前 7 日和 14 日最小、最大、平均 NDVI 表征植被物候，并结合 ClimateNA 气候变量、DEM 地形湿度变量、ABoVELandsat-derived AnnualDominant Landcover dataset、ALPHA3.0Predictive Landcover dataset、Soil LandscapesofCanadaVersion3.2dataset、HumanFootprintInventory(HFI) 和 CNFDB 火灾属性作为预测或控制变量。
directions.method_paradigm: 空间统计建模
used_assets: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Climate Data Record (CDR) of NDVI Version 4 dataset
directions.evidence_granularity: GPT/opus admitted open full text Methods/Data section

directions.research_question: 北美中部迁徙通道上秋季帝王蝶栖息群规模在 2007–2023 年间如何随时空变化，天气和植被条件能否解释这些变化？
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 逆风、低温和降雨阻碍迁徙飞行，会使栖息群增大；较高的 NDVI 代表更好的蜜源与中途停歇条件，从而影响栖息群规模。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 以 Journey North 栖息群最大计数为响应变量；以 NOAA CDR 0.05° 逐日 NDVI 在观测点 12.5 km 半径内的同日值，以及 Visual Crossing 观测前 7 天的气温、降水和顺风指标为协变量；用 HILDA+ 检验城市化采样偏差，用 PRISM 和 DAYMET 验证天气数据。
directions.method_paradigm: 贝叶斯空间变系数负二项模型（INLA）与 WAIC 模型平均
directions.evidence_granularity: audited open full text Methods/Data section

directions.research_question: 在陆气耦合强度不同的草地与森林生态系统中，广义互补关系的形状参数和潜在蒸发相关参数分别受陆面还是大气因素控制？
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 森林与外层大气强耦合使潜在蒸发相关参数随平均相对湿度变化，草地弱耦合使形状参数随长期土壤湿润程度变化。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 利用通量站点的月尺度实际蒸发、相对湿度和土壤含水量数据，拟合 sigmoid 型广义互补关系的两个参数，并建立参数与环境变量的相关性参数化方案以改进蒸发预测。
directions.method_paradigm: 通量站点参数反演与相关分析
directions.evidence_granularity: audited open full text Methods/Data section

directions.research_question: 加州城市地区居住邻里绿地（NDVI）及其变化是否影响出生体重和小于胎龄儿风险，这种关系是否因母亲种族/族裔而不同？
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 更高的居住区绿地可能缓解心理社会和环境压力，从而提高出生体重、降低小于胎龄儿风险。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 在 Google Earth Engine 中将 NOAA CDR AVHRR 逐日 NDVI 聚合为普查区-年均值，负值置零，作为暴露变量。按母亲居住普查区和出生年份与出生记录关联，并结合 2010 年人口普查的邻里劣势指数和个体协变量进行建模。
directions.method_paradigm: 横断面回归与母亲固定效应同胞设计
